question: Accept the design (the Copilot reader treats an answer as a review only when it has a review heading or its own line comment; anything else exits 5 as "copilot not run", never a round or clean; FO does not wait or re-request and names Copilot unread at the merge ask) and enter implementation? Approving accepts the recommendations for D1 (fail closed on any heading-less, comment-less answer) and D2 (no re-request after a refusal until the Captain says the quota is back).
